scope: Desktop mini-program host bridge, direct checked initialization, optional callbacks and deterministic package replay
checks: Deferred dimensions, resize, finite nonpositive DPR normalization, overflow rejection and initialization OOM followed by retry
Nonempty bridge replacement rollback, callback lifetime, resource and audio payloads with NUL bytes, and reentrant detachment
Zero XRT allocations, frees and reallocations when clearing an empty bridge and while dispatching 1,000 warmed audio calls without copying bytes
One native initialization call per call site and C11, C++11 and C++17 headers
Standalone dynamic and static executables omit the compiler libraries; only dynamic executables load the hosted XGE library
